sentences.text:
In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of  (Allowed) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Rahara Police  Station Case No. 125 of 2023 dated 20.03.2023 under Sections  498A/304B IPC Section 4 of the D.P. Act (corresponding to G.R.
 Case No. 2297 of 2023).
 And
In the matter of: Tanisha Khatun @ Pampi Khatun  ....petitioner.
Mr. Binay Panda  Mr. Subham Bhakar  ...for the State.

1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner is stated to be the 20 years old unmarried sister-in-law (sister of the husband) of the deceased who is stated to have committed suicide.
So far as allegation of demand of additional dowry, harassment and torture on the deceased is concerned
, we find it to be omnibus in nature against the present petitioner.
3. The investigation is stated to have progressed substantially.

4. Regard being had to the facts and submission, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, nature of evidence, her tender age and possibility of reform in her and substantial progress in the investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail in the event of her arrest by the Arresting Officer in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
5. The petitioner is directed to appear before the I.O. within 21 days from today along with a server copy or certified copy of this order.
6. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
7. The application being CRM (A) 2552 of 2023 is disposed of.
